scripts.dev: npm run prepare:server -- --optional && npm run prepare:version && tauri dev --config tauri.local-version.json
scripts.build: npm run prepare:server && npm run prepare:version && tauri build --config tauri.local-version.json
scripts.build:release:macos: npm run prepare:server -- --force && tauri build --bundles app --config tauri.release-version.json && mkdir -p src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg && ../scripts/create-macos-dmg.sh src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos "Talktome Server" "src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/Talktome Server_aarch64.dmg"
scripts.build:release:windows: npm run prepare:server -- --force && tauri build --bundles nsis --config tauri.release-version.json
